assessment: Using improved optical imaging of growing microtubules and improved data analysis, the authors find that microtubule growth fluctuations are less pronounced than previously reported and that GTP hydrolysis in microtubules increases these fluctuations. A mathematical model of microtubule growth suggests that occasionally exposed GDP at the microtubule end can be responsible for increased growth fluctuations. This work provides new mechanistic insight into the molecular mechanism of microtubule growth.
